Theatres

Welcome to Hillingdon Theatres - providing you with all the latest shows, events, activities and exhibitions.

You can also find lots of information on ways to get involved with our theatres, putting on a show, and spaces and costumes to hire.

Jack and the Beanstalk - Compass Panto

Join us for a fun-filled family pantomime packed with laughter, music and magical moments.

Book tickets

Costume hire

Browse the Compass Theatre's wardrobe of theatrical costumes and accessories to hire - and complete your production's wardrobe, ready for the big show.

Learn more

Dementia Friendly Daytime Disco

Friendly and fun sessions for those living with dementia, and their carer.

Find out more

Compass Classes and Clubs

Daytime, after-school and evening learning and participation opportunities for people of all ages.

Dementia Friendly Daytime Disco

Date: 19 May 2026

Also held on: 09 June 2026, 21 July 2026, 25 August 2026, 22 September 2026, 20 October 2026, 26 January 2027, 23 February 2027, 23 March 2027

Time: 1.00pm - 3.00pm

Location: Compass Theatre, Glebe Avenue, Ickenham, UB10 8PD

Cost: £7.50, including free entry for carers

Friendly and fun sessions for those living with dementia, and their carer.

Music provided by Brian Rowan, singing, and playing songs from the 60s, 70s and 80s. 

Open to adults
